characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Den yngste sønnen som alle undervurderer, men som er arbeidsom, rolig og smart nok til å overvinne både brødrenes intriger og trollets trusler.
characters.look: A lanky young man of about eighteen with messy straw-blond hair, sharp blue-grey eyes, a narrow freckled face and a crooked, easy smile. He wears a faded red knitted cap, a patched undyed linen shirt, a short brown wool waistcoat with deep pockets, grey-brown knee breeches, grey wool stockings and worn leather shoes.

characters.name: Den eldste broren
characters.description: Stallgutten som helst vil slippe unna arbeid, og som sammen med broren skryter Askeladden inn i det ene farlige oppdraget etter det andre.
characters.look: A tall, broad-shouldered man in his mid-twenties with a square jaw, short dark-brown hair, a thin moustache and a smug, lazy expression. He wears a dark-green wool jacket over a white shirt, brown breeches and tall black boots.

characters.name: Den mellomste broren
characters.description: Gartnergutten som blir grønn av misunnelse når lillebroren får skryt, og som hvisker med stallmesteren.
characters.look: A heavyset man of about twenty-two with round red cheeks, curly ginger hair, a sulky mouth and small, suspicious eyes. He wears a mustard-yellow wool tunic with a rope belt, patched brown trousers and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Herskeren på kongsgården som setter harde krav, men belønner Askeladden når han lykkes med de umulige oppdragene.
characters.look: A stout, elderly king with a long white beard, rosy cheeks, small round spectacles on a red nose and a greedy, delighted look whenever he sees treasure. He wears a simple gold crown, a long red robe trimmed with white fur and gold embroidery, and soft red slippers.

characters.name: Trollet
characters.description: En farlig og grådig kjempe som bor i fjellet på andre siden av vannet og vokter sine skatter, men lar seg lure av Askeladdens svar og knep.
characters.look: An enormous, ancient troll three times the height of a man, with grey-green skin like weathered rock patched with moss and lichen, a long knobbly nose, tiny black eyes under bushy brows, a wide mouth with two stubby teeth, huge ears, a tangled beard like dry grass and a young spruce growing from the top of his head. He wears a ragged hide tunic tied with rope and goes barefoot on huge flat feet.

characters.name: Trolldattera
characters.description: Trollets datter som vokter Askeladden og til slutt blir lurt når han får henne til å låne ham kniven.
characters.look: A huge troll woman, about three times as tall as a man, with a broad moss-green face, a long bumpy nose, small squinting eyes, heavy arms and one enormous reddish-brown braid that reaches the floor. She wears a patched grey wool dress, a faded red shawl and a coarse sacking apron, and goes barefoot.

places.name: the Grey Crag
places.look: A bare, rounded grey granite mountain rising straight out of the far shore of a wide mountain lake, with a strip of pebble beach, a few wind-bent birches and mossy boulders at its foot, and a tall, dark crack low in the rock face that leads inside.

places.name: the Mountain Hall
places.look: The trolls' home inside the mountain: a vast, smoky cave hall with rough grey walls and a high dark roof, lit by a big fire in a ring of stones. A long plank table with stump stools, a heavy wooden cupboard, iron hooks in the rock, a fattening pen of rough timber in one corner, and a tall arched wooden door with a small golden harp hanging above it.

- the Eldest Brother: A tall, broad-shouldered man in his mid-twenties with a square jaw, short dark-brown hair, a thin moustache and a smug, lazy expression. He wears a dark-green wool jacket over a white shirt, brown breeches and tall black boots.
- the Middle Brother: A heavyset man of about twenty-two with round red cheeks, curly ginger hair, a sulky mouth and small, suspicious eyes. He wears a mustard-yellow wool tunic with a rope belt, patched brown trousers and wooden clogs.

Story world: Old rural Norway. The King's manor is a cluster of dark log buildings with turf roofs, carved gables and a hall with small leaded windows, on the shore of a wide, deep mountain lake. Straight across the lake rises the Grey Crag, where the trolls live behind a crack in the rock. The seven silver ducks are ordinary-sized ducks of solid, shining silver. The kneading trough is a long, shallow, oval trough of dark wood, big enough for a man to sit in; Askeladden rows it with a short wooden paddle. The troll's bedspread is a heavy quilt of alternating silver and gold squares. The golden harp is a small golden lap harp with a carved swan's head at the top.

This story's season, light and colours: Late summer on a wide mountain lake: cool clear mornings, silver glints on grey-blue water and low golden evening sun on bare rock. Inside the mountain: smoky orange firelight and deep brown shadow.

Art style: Classic Norwegian folk-tale book illustration: fine pen-and-ink line work with transparent watercolour washes on warm, slightly textured off-white paper, in the tradition of 19th-century Scandinavian book illustration, like the plates of an old printed book of folk tales, with a deep red that comes back as the accent. The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Naturalistic proportions and expressive, characterful faces; every character has their own face, build, age and hair exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. Muted natural palette of fjord teal, slate blue, moss green, lichen grey, honey ochre, lingonberry red, ink black and birch white, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours, with the warm cream paper showing through the washes, with dramatic Nordic light: low sun, long shadows, blue dusk and firelight. Old rural Norway: dark spruce and pine forests, steep mountains, fjords, turf-roofed log farms, carved wood, homespun wool and linen. Trolls are enormous, ancient and earthy, like pieces of the landscape come alive, made of moss, bark, stone and lichen, and more grotesque-comic than frightening. Kings and princesses wear modest medieval finery. Careful composition with depth and atmosphere, one clear focal point and room for the landscape. Not cute or cartoonish, not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.

Rules:
- No text of any kind: no letters, words, numbers, signatures, captions, speech bubbles or logos.
- Every named character must match their model sheet and description exactly: the same face, hair, colours, clothes and proportions.
- Suitable for readers of all ages: no blood, wounds or gore, and no killing shown. Show danger and cruelty through atmosphere, posture and suspense, never through injury.
- Draw each named character only once.
- Show exactly the number of people, animals and things the description asks for, and no extra people.
- One clear moment that reads at a glance, as a single full-bleed picture with no border, frame or comic panels.
